title_zh: 索取社区阅读项目资助的书面条件

scenario.label_zh: 明确社区资助方案的受益人与自主范围
scenario.goal_zh: 明确资助受益对象和活动安排的自主范围，并约定收到书面条件后再决定是否接受

context_zh: 社区阅读项目负责人向资助方询问一项尚未接受的支持方案。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: Your financial backing could keep our reading sessions running. Who do you regard as the main beneficiary?

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: The local residents who use the sessions, particularly people who can't afford paid classes.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: Would our volunteers retain autonomy over the books and activities? We don't want a sponsor choosing the reading list.

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: Yes. The offer requires a short spending report, but it doesn't give us control over the programme.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: Please put those conditions in writing. We'll review them before deciding whether to accept.

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: Of course. I'll send the written offer, including that limit on our role.
